item.subject: science
item.stem:
Priya ties a bar magnet to a thread and hangs it freely from a wooden stand on the veranda of her home in Jaipur. After the magnet stops swinging, she notices that it settles in a particular direction.
Which statement correctly describes what she will observe and what it tells her?

options.A: The magnet stops at any random direction, and the end painted red is always the North pole.
options.B: The magnet settles along the east-west direction, and the end pointing east is the North pole.
options.C: The magnet settles along the north-south direction, and the end pointing towards north is the North pole.
options.D: The magnet settles along the north-south direction only if it is made of steel rather than iron.
